# graphiant_playbook_job_snapshot (Data Source)

The config inputs an Automation Workflows playbook job ran with, frozen when the job was created. Unlike graphiant_playbook_config, this does not change when the config is edited later. name, description, playbook and tags are empty for jobs created before the service started recording them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The module files the job actually ran with, even if the config was edited since.
data "graphiant_playbook_job_snapshot" "ntp" {
  job_id = graphiant_playbook_job.ntp.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `bundle_key` (String)
- `config_id` (String) Config that owned this run when the snapshot was taken.
- `description` (String) Config notes at job creation.
- `files` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `name` (String) Config display name at job creation.
- `playbook` (String) Playbook filename at job creation (e.g. network_bundle.yml).
- `tags` (String) Ansible --tags the job ran with; empty when no tags were applied.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String)
- `filename` (String)
- `module_key` (String)
